'''Nazastarool''' is a level 53 [[undead]] encountered during the [[Shilo Village]] quest. He has three forms; a [[Zombie]], a [[Skeleton]] and a [[Ghost (monster)|Ghost]]. All three forms have to be fought during the quest. Using a [[safe spot]] makes killing him trivial, as he can get stuck behind obstacles. He is found in [[Rashiliyia's Tomb]].

When defeated, he curses the player and disappears. If you take too long to defeat any of his phases Nazastarool will despawn, forcing you to start that phase over.

You are able to leave the tomb to restock, when you come back Nazastarool will be in the same phase you left him in.
